snapshots.captured_representation: Parliament of Australia Disallowance Alert 2026 lists the Carbon Credits (Carbon Farming Initiative—Improved Forest Management in Multiple-use Public Native Forests) Methodology Determination 2026 [F2026L00835]. Senator Cadell gave notice on 30 June 2026 to move disallowance; the motion was postponed on 17 August 2026 to 15 September 2026 and is marked 'To be resolved'. Mr Tehan also gave notice on 30 June 2026 to move disallowance and that notice is marked 'To be resolved'.

events.claim: A federal disallowance motion concerning the Carbon Credits (Carbon Farming Initiative—Improved Forest Management in Multiple-use Public Native Forests) Methodology Determination 2026 remains unresolved, with Senator Cadell's motion postponed to 15 September 2026; a separate House disallowance notice by Mr Tehan is also marked to be resolved.
The AI Kill Switch and Data Centre Control Bill 2026, sponsored by Andrew Gee MP, is currently before the House of Representatives after introduction on 7 September 2026.
